items.title: The five comparison properties hold for the h-topology over the small etale site with proper-morphism coefficients
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file etale-cohomology.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma verifies the five comparison properties of the standing situation for the h-topology over the small etale site, with coefficient subcategories given by pullbacks of torsion sheaves (statement lines 22647-22664). The proof (proof lines 22666-22715) checks the weak Serre axioms for A'_X through exactness and fullness of the pullback together with cohomological descent, and then verifies the five properties one by one from permanence of properness and finite presentation, the topological diagram, the description of the pullback, the proper comparison with torsion of pushforwards, and the existence of finite locally free covers. H2: five property checks with named inputs, all written out.
